alignments.note: Light verb taken pledges heads on the complement (rule 44); the of reaching the bare object joins the verb.

Construct noun keeps only its own word clothing; the ASV inverts the chain, promoting the rectum to object.
Supplied possessive their; no suffix or possessive morpheme (rule 18).
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the supplied the (rule 46).

bigde is the bare direct object of tafshit and the ASV keeps the verb a verb (stripped ... of), so the supplied of is the verb's under rule 44's supplied-preposition clause, discontinuous under rule 25; rule 33's closing paragraph runs the direct-object question first and sends the word here.
